# Which of your Actions jobs can hang for six hours?

> Paste your GitHub Actions workflow YAML and find every job with no timeout-minutes (or one set to the 360-minute default) — the jobs that can hang for six hours of billed runner time. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/actions-timeout-check/)
- [GitHub Actions timeout-minutes: the default, the cost, and what to set](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/actions-timeout-check/what-is-github-actions-timeout-minutes.html)
